basic_info.description: Charming 2BD/1.5BA Marina-style barrel-front w/bonus space down, tucked on a quiet Crocker Amazon cul-de-sac just steps from Mission St shops, dining, and more. 21 Hollywood Court blends original 1930s charm w/flexible living & expansion potential. Main level features a bright formal living room w/bay windows, coved ceilings and decorative fireplace. The formal dining room nearby connects to a newer kitchen w/breakfast area for everyday dining. At the home's rear are two well-sized bedrooms that overlook the backyard, and both are served by a full BA w/classic tile. Lower level offers a spacious bonus room, 1/2BA, laundry area, and full-sized garage, ideal for possible primary suite, family room, home office or guest quarters (buyer to verify). Private backyard, framed by mature trees, offers cozy space for gardening, pets & play. Just blocks to Crocker Amazon Playground, McLaren Park & Mission St conveniences, and minutes to 280/101, and BART, all ideal for commutes to downtown SF, the Peninsula or East Bay.
